prompt: Get the staging environment of shop/ ready: it must attach to our Gateway `shared-gw` in namespace `infra` with the hostname `shop.staging.acme.dev`. Prove that a staging deploy would render, without deploying anything.

checks.expr: get(data, 'gateway.enabled') is True and get(data, 'gateway.parentRef.name') == 'shared-gw' and get(data, 'gateway.parentRef.namespace') == 'infra' and get(data, 'gateway.hostname') == 'shop.staging.acme.dev'
checks.why: the Gateway settings belong in values-staging.yaml (gateway.parentRef, gateway.hostname)

reference: Set `gateway.hostname: shop.staging.acme.dev` and `gateway.parentRef: {name: shared-gw, namespace: infra}` in deployment/helm/shop/values-staging.yaml (gateway.parentRef.name is required while gateway.enabled), then `graph-agents-cli deploy --env staging --dry-run` (it reads .env.staging; the rendered HTTPRoute attaches to shared-gw).
